## Overview

This directory contains Root Cause Analyses related to incidents or issues originating from specific software applications, whether custom-built, commercial off-the-shelf (COTS), or SaaS solutions.
page_texts.3:
[rcas/application/README.md#examples-of-application-rcas]

## Examples of Application RCAs

- Application crashes due to coding errors or configuration issues
- Performance degradation in critical business applications (e.g., CRM, ERP)
- Integration failures between applications (e.g., API or middleware issues)
- Security vulnerabilities discovered in applications
- Data corruption or loss within application systems
- User experience issues affecting business operations
- Memory leaks or resource exhaustion in application processes
